tools.name: search_drawings
tools.description: Searches Overflow Design's hand-drawn drawings by what they show: 1,120 icons, 457 illustrations and 249 isometric drawings. tools.name: get_drawings
tools.description: Returns Overflow drawings by id, up to 20 at a time, as SVG or JSX. Icons and isometric stills of up to 32 KB come back inline as markup. Illustrations, larger isometric drawings and animated ones come back as a download link that works for fifteen minutes, with a curl command that saves the file; t

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: Lists what Overflow Design has: the three sets with their counts, styles and categories, and what this connection's licence key unlocks.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_drawings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
